headline: Jet2 Cuts Winter Capacity as Rising Fuel Expenses Dent Profits
summary: British airline and holiday operator Jet2 reduced its winter flying schedule after high fuel costs caused operating profit in the first half of the financial year to drop 18%.
why: European low-cost carriers face margin compression when jet fuel prices stay elevated and post-pandemic booking growth normalises.

impacts.name: Jet2
impacts.why: First-half profit slumped 18% due to elevated aviation fuel expenses and capacity curtailments.
